property_summary: For any target address and value, when the target's fallback reverts, the reference contract's sendMoney call must itself revert (so the call returns false via try/catch), whereas the mutant that ignores the low-level call success will not revert — breaking the rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a call that always succeeds (ignores returned success) and does not revert on failure, changing whether sendMoney reverts and thus observable state after the call.
